description:
## [1.3.0](https://github.com/RikoDEV/morphed-pl/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0) (2026-11-02)

### ✨ New Features

* add home screen dark mode and telemetry blocking ([777084d](https://github.com/RikoDEV/morphed-pl/commit/777084dd60110773a021b4370ac65d912973cd4b))

patches.name: Block Yanosik telemetry
patches.description: Blocks analytics, crash reporting, usage statistics, the notiOne SDK and Wi-Fi/cell tower data collection. Location reporting for POI alerts and traffic keeps working.

patches.name: Bypass Android Auto certificate checks
patches.description: Bypasses the Car App Library host certificate validation so Yanosik works on Android Auto.

patches.name: Home screen dark mode
patches.description: Makes the home screen follow the system light or dark theme.

patches.name: Remove Yanosik ads
patches.description: Removes banner ads, splash/start adverts and advert-based navigation POIs.

patches.name: Remove Yanosik radio
patches.description: Removes the built-in Radio Yanosik from the main screen and the map button.

patches.name: Unlock Yanosik PRO
patches.description: Reports an active premium entitlement and unlocks the PRO-only settings (view after launch, floating icon).
